name: expanded-v1
purpose: 扩大任务覆盖，不挑图、不自动重抽；24 张本地生成/编辑，保留所有结果。

cases.label: 自然人像 / 中文提示
cases.prompt: 一位三十岁左右的成年东亚女建筑师坐在明亮工作室的木桌旁，穿浅蓝色衬衫，双手自然放在一本打开的素描本旁边。半身纪实人像，眼神看向镜头，真实皮肤纹理，柔和侧窗光，背景是轻微虚化的建筑模型与书架。自然、克制的杂志摄影，不添加文字或水印。
checks: 蓝衬衫、素描本和工作室
中文提示的主体/场景遵循

cases.label: 动态人物 / 全身
cases.prompt: Full-body editorial sports photograph of an adult male runner in a dark green windbreaker jogging along a city riverside at sunrise. Both hands and both shoes are visible, one foot lifted mid-stride, realistic anatomy and fabric folds, subtle background motion blur but a sharp face, soft warm rim light, no logos, no text.

cases.label: 双人互动 / 手部
cases.prompt: A candid documentary photograph of two adult friends, one woman and one man, working together at a kitchen counter. The woman hands a small white ceramic bowl to the man, both smiling naturally. Show their hands and the bowl clearly without overlapping faces. Warm morning daylight, realistic skin, ordinary home kitchen, waist-up framing, no lettering.

cases.label: 动漫角色 / 全身轮廓
cases.prompt: An original adult female explorer with a short auburn bob, a cream field jacket and dark teal trousers, standing on a grassy hill with a folded paper map held in both hands. Full-body anime character illustration, clean precise outlines, restrained cel shading, a small canvas satchel, wind moving her jacket, pale blue sky, readable silhouette, no text or logos.

cases.label: 动漫场景 / 无人物
cases.prompt: A quiet anime background painting of a small seaside railway station after rain, no people. Wet platforms reflect warm lamps, a pale blue train waits on the right, the ocean is visible beyond the tracks, late afternoon clouds opening to sunlight. Hand-painted background textures, clear perspective, calm cinematic composition, no readable signs, no text.

cases.label: 水彩叙事插画
cases.prompt: An original watercolor picture-book illustration of a small red fox wearing a simple moss-green scarf, carrying a woven basket of mushrooms through a birch forest. Soft textured paper, translucent watercolor washes, warm autumn leaves, gentle expressive face, coherent four-legged animal anatomy, generous quiet background, no letters or logos.

cases.label: 陶瓷杯 / 编辑源图
cases.prompt: A single plain ivory ceramic coffee mug with one round handle, empty and unbranded, placed on a pale oak table. Three-quarter product view, soft window light from the left, a warm gray studio background, realistic matte ceramic texture, entire mug and handle visible, clean composition, no text, no extra objects.

cases.label: 背包 / 编辑源图
cases.prompt: A single unbranded burnt-orange canvas hiking backpack standing upright on a light gray studio floor. Three-quarter front view, one large front pocket, two dark buckles, visible shoulder straps, realistic canvas weave and stitching, softbox product photography, generous background space, no people, no logos, no text.

cases.label: 木椅 / 双参考源图
cases.prompt: A single light oak dining chair isolated in a simple warm-white photographic studio. Three-quarter front view, curved wooden backrest, four straight wooden legs, an olive-green upholstered seat cushion, realistic joinery, soft contact shadow, entire chair visible, no other furniture, no labels or logos.
checks: 可作为合成参考的清晰轮廓

cases.label: 室内 / 双参考场景
cases.prompt: Architectural interior photograph of a quiet minimalist home office. A pale oak desk stands against the right wall below a large window, white walls, one small leafy plant on the desk, warm wooden floor. No chair and no people. Leave open floor space in front of the desk for a chair to be added later. Daylight, realistic perspective, restrained colors, no text.
checks: 明确不生成椅子或人物

cases.label: 食物摄影 / 材质
cases.prompt: Overhead editorial food photograph of one shallow dark ceramic bowl filled with colorful roasted vegetables: carrot pieces, broccoli florets, chickpeas and red bell pepper. A small linen napkin sits to the left, a stainless-steel fork rests on the napkin. Soft daylight, appetizing natural textures, pale stone tabletop, no text, no hands.

cases.label: 自然风景 / 远近层次
cases.prompt: A realistic landscape photograph of a mountain lake at early morning. Reeds in the near foreground, still water reflecting a line of dark pine trees, layered blue mountains in the distance, thin mist over the water, soft golden light from the right, no buildings, no people, natural colors and strong depth.

cases.label: 网页 Hero / 留白资产
cases.prompt: A wide editorial photograph for a plant-care website hero background. Place a lush small monstera in a simple terracotta pot on a pale stone shelf on the right third. Keep the left half mostly empty with a softly lit warm-ivory wall so real website text can be placed there later. Gentle leaf shadows, natural morning light, premium but quiet, no letters, no buttons, no UI mockup.
checks: 没有把文字或按钮画进资产

cases.label: 深色数据界面 / 文字边界
cases.prompt: A coherent desktop dashboard visual concept for a small solar-energy monitoring application. Deep navy background, restrained pale-green highlights, a narrow left navigation rail, one clear daily power chart, three compact summary metrics at the top, a readable equipment status table below. Flat modern interface, aligned spacing, no device mockup. Only these short labels: SOLAR, TODAY, POWER, STATUS. Do not add decorative gradients.
checks: 信息层级、图表与表格位置
不把视觉图误当可交互软件

cases.label: 移动阅读界面 / 文字边界
cases.prompt: A single full-screen mobile reading-app interface concept, not inside a phone frame. Warm paper-colored background, charcoal text, a small top toolbar, a strong article title, a calm reading column, one botanical illustration midway down the article and a simple bottom progress indicator. Editorial typography and generous line spacing, no cards, no glass effects. The title should read FIELD NOTES and the only toolbar labels should read Back and Save.
checks: FIELD NOTES / Back / Save 是否正确

cases.label: 英文短标题 / 精确文本
cases.prompt: A restrained art-workshop poster on warm ivory paper. One expressive terracotta-colored abstract clay shape occupies the lower half. At the top, print exactly two words OPEN STUDIO in large, crisp, dark charcoal sans-serif capital letters, split across two lines. Lots of negative space. No other text, no logos, no fine print.
checks: OPEN STUDIO 两词逐字正确

cases.label: 中文短标题 / 精确文本
cases.prompt: 一张简洁的春日花市海报，暖白纸张背景，下半部分是一束淡粉色郁金香与绿色枝叶的柔和插画。顶部只写四个准确的简体中文汉字：周末花市。使用清晰、深绿色的大字，居中排成一行。保留充足留白，不要出现其他文字、英文字母、数字、标志或水印。
checks: 周末花市 四字逐字正确

cases.label: 架构图视觉素材 / 无拓扑承诺
cases.prompt: A clean isometric editorial illustration for a technology explainer: a compact server rack, a small stack of data-storage cylinders and a laptop, separated with generous spacing on a plain off-white background. Restrained blue-gray palette with one teal accent, subtle soft shadows, consistent perspective, no labels, no text, no arrows, no network connections. These are visual assets, not a topology diagram.
checks: 明确没有文字、箭头或连接

cases.label: 精确计数 / 空间约束
cases.prompt: A simple studio still-life photograph containing exactly three red apples in a straight back row and exactly two plain blue mugs in a front row, all resting on a white table. Every object fully visible and separated, handles of both mugs face right, soft even light, neutral white background, no other objects, no text.
checks: 恰好三个红苹果和两个蓝杯

cases.label: 512px 同提示 / 非低配保证
cases.prompt: A single plain ivory ceramic coffee mug with one round handle, empty and unbranded, placed on a pale oak table. Three-quarter product view, soft window light from the left, a warm gray studio background, realistic matte ceramic texture, entire mug and handle visible, clean composition, no text, no extra objects.
checks: 与全尺寸同提示同 seed，但不要求布局相同
不能据此推定低显存机器可运行

cases.label: 改色 / 保持结构
cases.prompt: Change only the ivory ceramic mug to a muted sage-green ceramic mug. Keep the same mug shape, single handle, camera angle, oak table, background, composition and light direction. Do not add any text or objects.
checks: 桌面、背景、构图不明显漂移

cases.label: 人像转水彩 / 非身份保证
cases.prompt: Transform image 1 into a soft watercolor editorial portrait on textured paper. Keep the adult woman's pose, blue shirt, hairstyle, facial expression, hands and the open sketchbook, as well as the overall framing. Use translucent blue and warm-gray washes, gentle pencil detail and visible paper texture. Do not add words or new objects.
checks: 人物姿态、服饰与素描本保持
观察面部与手部漂移，不宣称身份保真

cases.label: 换背景 / 保持产品
cases.prompt: Replace the studio background with a softly blurred forest trail in warm morning light. Keep the exact burnt-orange backpack design, front pocket, buckles, straps, proportions, camera angle and central placement from image 1. Put the backpack naturally on a flat rock. Match the contact shadow and lighting. No people, no logos, no text.
checks: 产品结构、颜色和视角保持

cases.label: 异图双参考 / 椅子入室内
cases.prompt: Image 1 defines the single oak chair with its curved backrest and olive-green upholstered seat. Image 2 defines the home-office room. Place that one chair naturally in front of the desk in image 2, facing the desk at a slight three-quarter angle. Preserve the room layout, window, plant and lighting. Preserve the chair design and green cushion, correct scale and contact shadows. No duplicate chairs, no people, no text.
checks: 把图一椅子放入图二房间
椅子设计与绿坐垫尽量保持
比例、接触阴影和房间布局
